title: Director
description: Indexing, live calls, takes, cuts and publishes, with their outcomes and errors, from the activity logs (docs/observability.md).

panels.title: Indexing
panels.description: Shorts asked for (director.index_requested) and what the AI worker made of them (director.indexed: ok, failed, or refused when the workspace was out of tokens).

targets.expr: sum by (activity, outcome) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director.index" | json | activity="director.index_requested" or activity="director.indexed" [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director.indexed" | json activity, tokens="target.inputTokens" | activity="director.indexed" | unwrap tokens | __error__="" [$__range]) by (activity))
sum(sum_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director.indexed" | json activity, tokens="target.outputTokens" | activity="director.indexed" | unwrap tokens | __error__="" [$__range]) by (activity))

panels.title: Live calls
panels.description: Calls that started (or were refused before they could), and how they ended.

targets.expr: sum by (activity, outcome) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director.call_" | json | activity="director.call_started" or activity="director.call_ended" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Why calls ended
panels.description: HUNG_UP when the browser left, TIMEOUT at the ten-minute limit, an error code otherwise.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director.call_ended" | json activity, durationMs | activity="director.call_ended" | unwrap durationMs | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (activity)

sum by (activity, outcome) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director." | json | activity="director.take_recorded" or activity="director.take_reviewed" or activity="director.scene_checked" [$__interval]))

avg_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director.take_reviewed" | json activity, outcome, score="target.score" | activity="director.take_reviewed" | outcome="ok" | unwrap score | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (activity)

panels.title: Cuts and publishes
panels.description: Cuts saved, posts drafted, publishes started, and how each publish ended (refused with its code: the demo account, no YouTube permission, the day's quota).

targets.expr: sum by (activity, outcome) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director." | json | activity="director.cut_saved" or activity="director.publish_copy_drafted" or activity="director.publish_started" or activity="director.published" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Refusals and errors
panels.description: Every Director activity that didn't end ok in the time range, by its code.

targets.expr: sum by (activity, outcome, reason) (count_over_time({namespace="$namespace"} |= "director." | json | activity=~"director.+" | outcome!="ok" [$__range]))

panels.title: Director failures
panels.description: Each failure as it was logged, with who it happened to; open a line for its trace.
